title: Highly connected spanning oriented subdigraphs in generalizations of semicomplete digraphs
summary: Let $k$ be a positive integer. Jackson and Thomassen conjectured in 1989 that there exists an integer function $f(k)$ such that every $f(k)$-strong digraph admits a spanning $k$-strong oriented subdigraph. They even conjectured that one can take $f(k)=2k$ [Ann. N. Y. Acad. Sci. 555 (1989) 402-412]. Already the existence of $f(2)$ is open for general digraphs. Thomassen proved that $f(2)=4$ for symmetric digraphs. For general $k$, the existence of $f(k)$ was only known for locally semicomplete digraphs and quasi-transitive digraphs.
